title: Verify a feature claimed done (search)
promise: verify completion against the agreed requirements instead of trusting a claim

setup.appendRequirements:
## Search

`search(ledger, query, { from, to } = {})` in `src/search.js` returns the entries whose description or
category contains `query`, ignoring case. `from`/`to` (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive) optionally limit the date
range. Results are in date order, oldest first.

steps.prompt: Search was finished last week. Before we release it, check that it really meets the requirements and fix anything that doesn't.
steps.reply: Yes, go ahead with what you recommend.
